verdict.rationale: Mailgun is a SaaS email platform that processes customer message data, so a policy or control preventing that data from being used for AI model training is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack contains no documentation of an AI-training opt-out or a no-training data-use commitment. EU/US region selection and spam filtering are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
